label: Bible Study
prompt: What man of you, having an hundred _____, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
verse: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
note: The lost sheep — first of three 'lost' parables in Luke 15, followed by a coin and a son.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy _____ and full of glory:
verse: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
note: Peter writes to people who never saw Jesus in person, yet love Him with a joy too big for words.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And she said, As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two _____, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
verse: And she said, As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
note: The widow had a handful of meal, a little oil, and two sticks for one last meal — then Elijah asked for the first cake.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy _____: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
verse: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
note: The psalmist, far from Jerusalem near the Jordan's headwaters, feels the waves of trouble rolling over him.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Moreover, because I have set my _____ to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
verse: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
note: David gave his own treasure for the temple 'because I have set my affection to the house of my God.' Giving follows the heart.
